items.headline: Flood Watch issued October 15 at 9:16AM AKDT until October 16 at 1:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
A stronger atmospheric river continues to move over the panhandle
Thursday, lasting through Friday morning. Multiple waves moving up
will bring persistent moderate to heavy rain for much of the southern
half of the panhandle, with the heaviest rain expected late morning
through the evening hours Thursday. Elevated gusty winds are expected
alongside this heavier rainfall, with the strongest winds expected
Thursday night. Prolonged periods of moderate to heavy rain will

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 15 at 8:31AM AKDT until October 15 at 4:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph.

* WHERE...City and Borough of Sitka, Prince of Wales Island, and
Western Kupreanof Island and Kuiu Island.

* WHEN...Until 4 PM AKDT this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down.
items.areas: City and Borough of Sitka; Western Kupreanof and Kuiu Island; Prince of Wales Island
items.instruction: Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 15 at 8:31AM AKDT until October 16 at 4:00AM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 55 mph.

* WHERE...Annette Island and Ketchikan Gateway Borough.

* WHEN...Until 4 AM AKDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Highest wind gusts are expected Thursday night
into Friday. Gusts above 1000 ft may exceed 60 mph.

Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 15 at 4:00AM AKDT until October 16 at 4:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow and blowing snow expected. Total snow accumulations up
to one inch. Winds gusting as high as 40 mph.

* WHERE...Central and Eastern Beaufort Sea Coast.

* WHEN...From 4 PM this afternoon to 4 PM AKDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Areas of blowing snow could
reduce visibility below one half mile at times.
items.areas: Central Beaufort Sea Coast; Eastern Beaufort Sea Coast
items.instruction: Slow down and use caution while traveling.
